_note: Weapons (DECISIONS #207, #220): min = tier + lvl * max(1, tier-2), max = max[0] + lvl * max[1]; a hit deals floor((min+max)/2) (no RNG). T2 max/lvl is +2; T4/T5 base max is raised. Under-strength weapon damage is divided by (1 + missing Str) and block is zeroed. str = SPD STRReq at +0 (8 + 2*tier, Greataxe 8 + 2*(tier+1)), lowered at +1, +3, +6, +10 like SPD. delay = SPD DLY, reach = SPD RCH, acc = SPD ACC, block = SPD defenseFactor [base, per lvl] (ceil(N/2) DR), surprise_pct = SPD dagger-family surprise roll. Armor uses dr_per_lvl / barrier_per_lvl (#218).

worn_shortsword.name: Worn Shortsword
worn_shortsword.spd_desc: A quite short sword, worn down through heavy use. It is both weaker and a bit lighter than a shortsword in better condition.

cudgel.name: Cudgel
cudgel.spd_desc: A small brass mace, made more as a self-defense tool for nobles than as an adventuring weapon.

studded_gloves.name: Studded Gloves
studded_gloves.spd_desc: These studded gloves don't provide any real protection, but they act as a serviceable weapon while keeping the hands free.

rapier.name: Rapier
rapier.spd_desc: A slim straight sword that offers some protection in exchange for less slashing power.

dagger.name: Dagger
dagger.spd_desc: A simple iron dagger with a worn wooden handle.

mages_staff.name: Mage's Staff
mages_staff.spd_desc: Crafted by the Mage himself, this staff is a unique magical weapon which can be imbued with a wand.
mages_staff.note: Heirloom: +1 melee damage every 6 hero levels (DECISIONS #64)

shortsword.name: Shortsword
shortsword.spd_desc: A quite short sword, only a few inches longer than a dagger.

hand_axe.name: Hand Axe
hand_axe.spd_desc: A light axe, most commonly used for felling trees. The wide blade works well against foes as well.

spear.name: Spear
spear.spd_desc: A slender wooden rod tipped with sharpened iron.

quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
quarterstaff.spd_desc: A staff of hardwood, its ends are shod with iron.

dirk.name: Dirk
dirk.spd_desc: A longer thrusting dagger, gives a bit more steel to plunge into foes.

sickle.name: Sickle
sickle.spd_desc: A handheld farming tool that can double as a strong but unwieldy weapon.

sword.name: Sword
sword.spd_desc: A nicely balanced sword. Not too large, but still notably longer than a shortsword.

mace.name: Mace
mace.spd_desc: The large iron head of this weapon inflicts substantial damage.

scimitar.name: Scimitar
scimitar.spd_desc: A thick curved blade. Its shape allows for faster, yet less powerful attacks.

round_shield.name: Round Shield
round_shield.spd_desc: This large shield effectively blocks attacks and makes a decent weapon in a pinch.

sai.name: Sai
sai.spd_desc: Two thin blades meant to be wielded in one hand each. Excellent for tearing down enemies with a flurry of cuts.

whip.name: Whip
whip.spd_desc: While the barbed length of rope at the end of this weapon deals poor damage, its reach cannot be matched.

longsword.name: Longsword
longsword.spd_desc: This sword's long razor-sharp steel blade shines reassuringly, though its size does make it quite heavy.

battle_axe.name: Battle Axe
battle_axe.spd_desc: The enormous steel head of this battle axe puts considerable heft behind each wide stroke.

flail.name: Flail
flail.spd_desc: A spiked ball attached to a handle by a length of chain. Very unwieldy, but devastating if it lands a solid hit.

runic_blade.name: Runic Blade
runic_blade.spd_desc: A mysterious weapon from a distant land, with a bright blue blade.
runic_blade.spd_note: SPD's Runic Blade also boosts its enchantment; this game has no weapon enchantments.

assassins_blade.name: Assassin's Blade
assassins_blade.spd_desc: A small wavy blade made of obsidian, difficult to use despite being lightweight, but deadly if it finds the right mark.

crossbow.name: Crossbow
crossbow.spd_desc: A fairly intricate weapon which shoots bolts at exceptional speeds. While it isn't designed for it, this crossbow's heft and sturdy construction make it a decent melee weapon as well.
crossbow.spd_note: SPD's Crossbow also empowers thrown darts; this game has no thrown weapons.

katana.name: Katana
katana.spd_desc: A slender sword with a large metal guard above the handle.

greatsword.name: Greatsword
greatsword.spd_desc: This towering blade inflicts heavy damage by investing its heft into every swing.

war_hammer.name: War Hammer
war_hammer.spd_desc: Few creatures can withstand the crushing blow of this towering mass of lead and steel, but it takes great strength to use effectively.

glaive.name: Glaive
glaive.spd_desc: A massive polearm consisting of a sword blade on the end of a pole.

greataxe.name: Greataxe
greataxe.spd_desc: Meant to be wielded over the shoulder, this titanic axe is as powerful as it is heavy.

greatshield.name: Greatshield
greatshield.spd_desc: More like a mobile wall than a shield, this gigantic mass of metal aids defense, but doesn't leave much room for attacking.

gauntlet.name: Stone Gauntlet
gauntlet.spd_desc: This massive gauntlet is made of crimson fabric with heavy magical stone layered on top. The fabric tightens around you, making the thick stone plates almost like a second skin. Swinging such a heavy weapon requires strength, but adds tremendous force to your blows.

war_scythe.name: War Scythe
war_scythe.spd_desc: This large and unwieldy tool has been reinforced to make it better at cutting foes than crops.

wand_firebolt.name: Wand of Firebolt
wand_firebolt.desc: Bolt: 4 damage (ignores DR), 2 charges. Burns grass.

potion_experience.name: Potion of Experience
potion_experience.desc: Grants a level's worth of XP.

potion_toxic.name: Potion of Toxic Gas
potion_toxic.desc: Choking gas: lose 25% of max HP.

potion_shielding.name: Potion of Shielding
potion_shielding.desc: Your next fight starts with +max(10, 30% of max HP) Barrier, up to half your max HP.

scroll_identify.name: Scroll of Identify
scroll_identify.desc: Identifies every unknown ring and wand in your backpack.

scroll_teleport.name: Scroll of Teleportation
scroll_teleport.desc: Whisks you past the current encounter.

potion_invisibility.name: Potion of Invisibility
potion_invisibility.desc: Your next fight starts with you unseen for 3 ticks: your first blow is a Surprise.

potion_haste.name: Potion of Haste
potion_haste.desc: Your next fight: enemies lose their first 1.5 ticks.

potion_levitation.name: Potion of Levitation
potion_levitation.desc: Your next fight: you float over traps.

potion_frost.name: Potion of Frost
potion_frost.desc: Drinking it freezes you: you lose your first 1.5 ticks next fight.

potion_liquid_flame.name: Potion of Liquid Flame
potion_liquid_flame.desc: Drinking it burns you: lose 15% of max HP.

potion_paralytic.name: Potion of Paralytic Gas
potion_paralytic.desc: Drinking it paralyzes you: you lose your first 2.5 ticks next fight.

scroll_recharging.name: Scroll of Recharging
scroll_recharging.desc: Your next fight: +1 staff charge and +1 cloak charge.

scroll_lullaby.name: Scroll of Lullaby
scroll_lullaby.desc: Your next fight: enemies start asleep for 2 ticks (bosses resist).

scroll_retribution.name: Scroll of Retribution
scroll_retribution.desc: Your next fight opens with a blast: each non-boss foe takes half your missing HP (min 2).

scroll_terror.name: Scroll of Terror
scroll_terror.desc: Your next fight: enemies recoil a tile and lose 1 tick (bosses resist).

scroll_transmutation.name: Scroll of Transmutation
scroll_transmutation.desc: Turns the first ring or wand in your backpack into a different one of the same kind.

wand_lightning.name: Wand of Lightning
wand_lightning.desc: Bolt: 7 damage (ignores DR), 2 charges. Chains through water.

wand_frost.name: Wand of Frost
wand_frost.desc: Bolt: 3 damage (ignores DR) and chills: the target's next action is delayed 1 tick (1.5 from hero Lv 15). 2 charges.

wand_corrosion.name: Wand of Corrosion
wand_corrosion.desc: Bolt: 2 damage (ignores DR) and 3 poison (+1 per 6 hero levels). 2 charges.

wand_blast_wave.name: Wand of Blast Wave
wand_blast_wave.desc: Bolt: 3 damage (ignores DR) and knocks the target back a tile (2 tiles from hero Lv 15). Chasms kill. 2 charges.

wand_disintegration.name: Wand of Disintegration
wand_disintegration.desc: Bolt: 4 damage (ignores DR) to every enemy on the line. Walls still stop it. 2 charges.

wand_transfusion.name: Wand of Transfusion
wand_transfusion.desc: Bolt: 3 damage (ignores DR); heals you 2 HP (+1 per 10 hero levels) when it hits. 2 charges.

wand_prismatic_light.name: Wand of Prismatic Light
wand_prismatic_light.desc: Bolt: 4 damage (ignores DR); lights up hidden traps within 2 tiles of where it lands. 2 charges.

wand_regrowth.name: Wand of Regrowth
wand_regrowth.desc: Bolt: 1 damage (ignores DR); roots the target for 2 ticks and grows tall grass around where it lands. 2 charges.

ring_energy.name: Ring of Energy
ring_energy.desc: +1 staff charge, +2 max HP (+2 HP per level).

ring_furor.name: Ring of Furor
ring_furor.desc: Melee attacks take 15% less time. -5% more per level.

ring_haste.name: Ring of Haste
ring_haste.desc: Steps take 15% less time. -5% more per level.

ring_sharpshooting.name: Ring of Sharpshooting
ring_sharpshooting.desc: +1 damage with the Spirit Bow and staff bolts. +1 per 2 levels.

ring_elements.name: Ring of Elements
ring_elements.desc: Fire, lightning, gas and other piercing magic hurt you a third less. -7% more per level.

ring_force.name: Ring of Force
ring_force.desc: +2 melee damage while wielding a tier-1 weapon (fists, dagger, gloves, staff). +1 per level.

chalice_blood.name: Chalice of Blood
chalice_blood.desc: +6 max HP (+3 per level; levels by use).

talisman_foresight.name: Talisman of Foresight
talisman_foresight.desc: +1 search radius; hidden traps next to you are revealed. (+1 search radius per 2 levels; levels by use)

horn_plenty.name: Horn of Plenty
horn_plenty.desc: Rations last 25% longer (better per level; levels by use).

cape_thorns.name: Cape of Thorns
cape_thorns.desc: An enemy that hits you in melee takes 1 damage back (+1 per 2 levels; levels by use).

ethereal_chains.name: Ethereal Chains
ethereal_chains.desc: Once per fight, the nearest enemy 3+ tiles away is dragged next to you (bosses resist). From +1 it is held 0.5 tick per level.

timekeepers_hourglass.name: Timekeeper's Hourglass
timekeepers_hourglass.desc: Each fight opens with enemies frozen 0.5 tick (+0.25 per level; bosses immune).

sandals_nature.name: Sandals of Nature
sandals_nature.desc: Stepping into tall grass roots adjacent enemies 0.5 tick (+0.25 per level).
